description: Read more turns from an accessible private work session. Use session_id returned by get_task_context and cursor to page through the source, or a matched session's excerpt from search_my_work: its cursor, limit 1 and its text_offset read the passage found and on from it.

text_offset.description: For a long message, repeat its cursor with limit 1 and the returned next_text_offset.

name: get_session_excerpt
title: Get Session Excerpt
